description: Led content strategy and integrated marketing across a 37-account social media matrix, growing cumulative following to 1 million within one year. Built and managed a team of 10, orchestrating cross-platform campaigns that generated $3M in signed contracts. Oversaw content development, community operations, and online events.

Directed content creation, character interviews, and publishing for a Chinese-language magazine in the UK. Planned cultural and creative events in collaboration with the V&A Museum, British Museum, Tate, and Ullens Center for Contemporary Art, reaching over 10 million exposures. Managed digital content strategy, user feedback analysis, and media promotion.

Produced art enlightenment short videos accumulating over 10 million views. Designed and executed online courses on art techniques and appreciation, coordinating with instructors and artists. Led exhibition planning for notable events including the China Hanmo Qingzhou Calligraphy and Painting Annual Conference.
